launches.title: Ooak Data: Turn internal company data into a training ground where AI agents can be trained on real work
launches.tagline: The bottleneck to smarter agents isn't compute. It's real data. We unlock it.
launches.body:
**TL;DR** Ooak Data turns internal company data into a training ground where AI agents can be tested on real work.\
\
[https://drive.google.com/file/d/1EgbFzN-g4cVY-dk7ZPH6gR37F28D56xo](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1EgbFzN-g4cVY-dk7ZPH6gR37F28D56xo/view?usp=sharing)

**The problem**

AI agents still fail on real work: the messy, multi-tool, permission-heavy workflows inside actual companies. You can't synthesize it either, real org charts, permissions, and cross-tool dependencies don't come out of a generator. You have to source it from real companies and make it safe. That's the hard part, and it's what we do.

**Our Solution**

We connect to a company's tools (Gmail, Slack, Notion, Jira, Drive, SharePoint) and anonymize everything into a digital twin: structurally identical, but privacy-safe. Labs use our product to train and evaluate AI agents on real work.

We're working with multiple frontier labs and are now well above 7 figures in revenue. We've cut ingestion-to-delivery time 3x since launch, across data from 20 companies.

**The team**

We’re a team of 3 cofounders: Pierre-Louis, Grégoire and Thomas and spent our careers inside the messy company systems we now replicate.

**Our asks**

* If you're training or evaluating agents on real workflows, we'd love to talk.
* Connections with companies abo 20+ FTEs, operating, winding down, or recently closed. Know someone who fits? **Add them [here](https://form.typeform.com/to/PjHdZmDW)**, or if it's your own company, grab [**15 min**](https://calendar.google.com/appointments/schedules/AcZssZ142jxQGEjB1PR9skAe17Nf7Pjf8G8EszSPcRhZIzmZXGCkn05REmmAmqPvMgWTYUMwbQNwinIF). Curious what a dataset is worth? Try our [**simulator**](https://ooakdata.com/partner).\
  feel free to reach out to us: [pierrelouis@ooakdata.com](mailto:pierrelouis@ooakdata.com)
